name: mcollina/oauth
summary: Implements and reviews OAuth 2.0/2.1 authorization code + PKCE flows in Fastify, including JWT validation, refresh token rotation, and route protection. Use when building or debugging a Fastify login flow, validating access tokens, fixing redirect URI or state/CSRF errors, or auditing an OAuth implementation against RFC 6749/6750/7636 and the OAuth 2.1 hardening rules.
